title: Vortex Suggest Objects Loading State
description: When right-clicking a vortex and clicking Suggest objects, the menu briefly shows no collision-free placement before results arrive. Fix so waiting is not displayed as no solution.
summary: Suggest menu vortex column now shows the specific port label (template.label, scene instance vortex.label, or vortexKind fallback) instead of resolving through the vortex-kind catalog. Added label to ObjectKindVortexTemplate, brushCandidateSourceVortexLabel, puzzle3dBrushSceneFixtureRef, and placement uses template label when set.
